newsitem.title: JAPAN: Taiheiyo Kouhatsu says to liquidate two units.
newsitem.headline: Taiheiyo Kouhatsu says to liquidate two units.

text.p: Japanese real estate company Taiheiyo Kouhatsu Inc said on Thursday that it would liquidate two of its units, including an Australian subsidiary, by the end of March 1998.
Taiheiyo Australia Pty Ltd in Sydney and a unit in Tokyo, which are involved in a coal project in Australia, have not been able to meet profit targets, Taiheiyo said.
Taiheiyo said it expected to include an extraordinary loss of about 2.2 billion yen in its parent earnings in the year to March 31, 1998, due to the planned liquidation of the units.
Earlier on Thursday, Taiheiyo revised its net earnings forecast for the six months to September 30.
It said that it would post an interim net loss of one billion yen against its previous forecast of a net profit of 50 million yen.
The company, however, maintained its full-year net profit forecast of 300 million yen announced in May.
